family: R14-B live-clock fidelity audit: HTF forming-bar leak check on the standing-best feature chain
hypothesis: WindowStore.at() + SwingStore.sample() can only ever return fully-closed HTF bars (frames drop incomplete buckets; ends searchsorted side=right on bucket close_time <= signal_time), so backtest features match the live closed-candle loop EXACTLY with no look-ahead. Expect per-timeframe verdict CLEAN x5 and NO code changes.

checks.A_alignment: every decision signal_time equals candles.close_time[bar_index]; 5m grid contiguous
checks.B_closed_only: per TF, last used bar close_time <= signal_time AND staleness = T - close in [0, TF period) for ALL 5628 decisions (vectorized)
checks.C_bucket_structure: per TF frame: opens epoch-aligned, contiguous step == TF, close == open + TF - 1ms (all bars); constituent 5m-count == expected on samples
checks.D_live_rebuild: truncate base candles to close_time <= T, rebuild SwingStore, sample(T) bit-identical to full-history sample + stored close/atr5/atr4; subset rows [0, 1500, 3000, 4500, last]
checks.E_boundary_math: synthetic decisions at real 5m closes on 15m+1h / 4h / 1d boundaries + one non-boundary; print per-TF last-bar open/close/staleness
checks.F_entry_alignment: frozen majority_1x + confirmed_1x normal trades: entry_index >= bar_index + 1 for every trade (read-only)

pass_criteria.CLEAN: all checks pass for the timeframe; no future information; live rebuild bit-identical
pass_criteria.LEAK: any check fails; stop, report mechanism + file:line, implement strict fix + test + rerun (step 3 of brief)

notes: Audit only. No execution-engine, cost, registry, or shared-file changes. New files only; never overwrite existing dirs.
